_comment: Single source of truth for exercises, form-error classes and rep-counting thresholds. Copy this file to formcoach-app/mobile/assets/config/labels.json whenever it changes. Class names are '<exercise>__<error>'.

squat.camera_hint: Phone at hip height, 2-3 m away, whole body in frame, turned about 45 degrees from facing you.

lunge.camera_hint: Phone at hip height, 2-3 m away, side-on so your front leg is clearly visible.

chest_press.camera_hint: Phone about 1.5 m away at bench height, upper body and both arms in frame.
